hunks.baseline: *…Could this be some kind of dark art?*
hunks.sol: *…So it is a dark art after all.*

hunks.baseline: “What are you so surprised about? It’s not like you’re seeing this face for the first time.”
hunks.sol: “What’s so surprising? This isn’t the first or second time you’ve seen my face.”

hunks.baseline: This was the greatest humiliation of my life.
hunks.sol: This was an all-time humiliation play.

hunks.baseline: “He’s on the first floor. He’s drinking it up with Young Hero Cheongpung.”
hunks.sol: “He’s downstairs. He’s drinking it up with Young Hero Cheongpung.”

hunks.baseline: “He is? How long?”
hunks.sol: “Yeah? How long?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know exactly. I only woke up not long ago, but I asked the server earlier. He said it had already been more than three shichen.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know exactly. I only woke up not long ago, but I asked the waiter earlier. He said it had already been more than three shichen.”

hunks.baseline: I wanted to smash those villains’ heads in with a liquor bottle and shout, “Justice has been served!” But I held myself back.
hunks.sol: I wanted to crack those thugs’ heads open with a liquor bottle and shout, “Justice has been served!” But I held myself back.

hunks.baseline: “I said I’m running. What about it? Do you want to come with me?”
hunks.sol: “I said I’m running. What, you want to come with me?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you running away?”
hunks.sol: “Wait, why are you running away?”

hunks.baseline: “If you mean the Head Elder?”
hunks.sol: “By what happened earlier, you mean the Head Elder?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. If that’s what you mean, Young Hero Cheongpung and I already…”
hunks.sol: “Yes. If it’s about that, Young Hero Cheongpung and I already…”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, you know?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, so you already knew.”

hunks.baseline: “Here. This is the reason.”
hunks.sol: “Here, the reason.”

hunks.baseline: After checking the cover of the old martial arts manual, Hyuk Mujin muttered,
hunks.sol: After checking the cover of the worn old book, Hyuk Mujin muttered,

hunks.baseline: “All right, here’s a question. What exactly is the relationship between Jopil, who possessed the Fire Gate Clan’s Flame Divine Palm manual, and Jeok Cheongang?”
hunks.sol: “All right, here’s a question. What exactly is the relationship between Jopil, who possessed the Fire Gate Clan’s martial art—the Flame Divine Palm manual—and Jeok Cheongang?”

hunks.baseline: “If they aren’t master and disciple, what are they? Father and son? Considering how foul-tempered they both are, that actually has some merit. Don’t you think?”
hunks.sol: “If they aren’t master and disciple, what are they? Father and son? Given how foul-tempered they both are, that actually has some merit. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “Even if Jopil was Great Hero Jeok’s Disciple, we merely did our duty. He was the one who charged at us and tried to kill us first.”
hunks.sol: “Even if Jopil was Great Hero Jeok’s Disciple, we merely did our duty. And he was the one who charged at us and tried to kill us first.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. Do you want to keep it and burn to death?”
hunks.sol: “Of course. Who’d want to swallow it and burn to death?”

hunks.baseline: “Am I insane? Living a long and uneventful life is my philosophy. That’s why I even make my dumps thin and long on purpose!”
hunks.sol: “Am I insane? Living long and thin is my life’s philosophy. That’s why I even shit thin and long on purpose!”

hunks.baseline: “Where is it now? Where is that thing?”
hunks.sol: “That thing—where is it now?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you suddenly bringing that up?”
hunks.sol: “Why bring that up all of a sudden?”

hunks.baseline: A wrinkled face suddenly appeared. It looked up at me, my body draped over the window, and grinned.
hunks.sol: A wrinkled face suddenly appeared. It looked up at me, leaning out over the windowsill, and grinned.
